Test Case 1: Templates Endpoint

Input:
  - Endpoint: GET /v2/activities/templates?limit=5
  - Method: curl from devbob pod to backend service
  - Backend: http://metabob-rpc-api.metabob.svc.cluster.local:8080

Expected Output:
  - Template count: 3-10 templates
  - Response format: {"templates": [...]}
  - Each template has: activity_id, variant_id, description, etc.
  - Cache fallback working (detects inconsistency, queries SurrealDB)

Validation:
  - Count templates in response JSON
  - Verify count >= 3 and <= 10
  - PASS if in range, FAIL otherwise
